name: members-stack
title: Members Stack
description: Who has access, drawn one way everywhere: 24px faces overlapped 6px, at most three and a "+N" pill of the same height, active people first; only you, everyone in a space and a team as their own forms; names on hover and one members popover.

meta.whenToUse: Show who has access to or is in a place: the page bar's members slot, a space or record header, the Share button, a list row's Members cell (with count).
meta.whenNotToUse: A picker of people (PeoplePicker) or a full member list (DataList).
